does: Sends the client back to the main menu: clears the state queue; when the current state is already Menu it queues only LoadMenu and Menu (no StartLoading, no video); otherwise, unless a save is in progress (SavegameManager+0xf9), it queues a StartLoading built by the constructor with the GameOverPlaylistQueue it is given (callers pass an empty queue, ecl::GameProtocol::ProcessMsg passes one from a server message), then the unload states, LoadModule when the base module changes, LoadMenu, StopLoading and Menu.
